2608.16467.title: Computational KJ-Ho: An Analyst-Bias-Free Insight Extraction Framework from Large-Scale Qualitative Data Using Domain-Specialized LLMs
2608.16467.paper_summary: The qualitative research methodologies that underpin consumer-insight generation - the KJ method, Grounded Theory, and Thematic Analysis - share a structural constraint: the cognitive processing capacity of the human analyst. Replication research further shows that conclusions vary substantially across analysts analyzing identical data (analyst bias). This paper proposes Computational KJ-Ho (the Kawakita Jiro method), a theoretical framework that computationally realizes the KJ method's epistemology - letting structure emerge from the data itself without imposing the analyst's preconceptions - an orientation we term "analyst-bias-free." The framework employs a domain-specialized LLM built through continued pre-training (CPT) on a marketing-research corpus and supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on expert-curated insight pairs, organized as a three-layer architecture: data structuring, insight extraction, and strategy generation. Two preliminary studies in the Japanese marketing context support the necessity of CPT-based domain specialization. The paper makes five contributions: (1) a theoretical integration of the KJ method, Grounded Theory, and Peircean abduction into a single epistemological commitment of data-driven explanation generation; (2) a three-layer architecture leveraging domain-specialized embeddings for cross-interview analysis; (3) two novel evaluation metrics, InsightExtraction-F1 and MarketingQA; (4) explicit engagement with the WEIRD problem, centering a non-Western methodology; and (5) five practice-derived problem formulations from nearly three decades of marketing-research practice, translated into design requirements. The human analyst retains a supervisory role. This is a concept paper presented ahead of empirical validation.
2608.16467.paper_summary_zh: 質性研究方法論支撐消費者洞察生成的 - KJ 方法、基礎理論和主題分析 - 共享一個結構性限制：人類分析師的認知處理能力。重複研究進一步顯示，分析相同數據的分析師之間的結論存在顯著差異（分析師偏見）。本文提出了計算 KJ-Ho（川喜田二郎方法），這是一個理論框架，計算性地實現 KJ 方法的認識論 - 讓結構從數據本身中出現，而不強加分析師的先入之見 - 我們稱之為“無分析師偏見”的取向。該框架使用了一個通過持續預訓練（CPT）在市場研究語料庫上和在專家策劃的洞察對上進行監督微調（SFT）的領域專用 LLM，組織為三層架構：數據結構化、洞察提取和策略生成。在日本市場背景下的兩項初步研究支持基於 CPT 的領域專業化的必要性。本文做出了五項貢獻：（1）將 KJ 方法、基礎理論和皮爾斯的推斷理論整合為一個數據驅動解釋生成的單一認識論承諾；（2）一個利用領域專用嵌入進行跨訪談分析的三層架構；（3）兩個新穎的評估指標，InsightExtraction-F1 和 MarketingQA；（4）明確參與 WEIRD 問題，聚焦於非西方方法論；以及（5）從近三十年的市場研究實踐中衍生的五個實踐問題表述，轉化為設計要求。人類分析師保留監督角色。這是一篇在實證驗證之前提出的概念論文。
2608.16467.author: Kasumi Ban et.al.
